pages.text: The Network Controller system in Refined Storage 2 has been completely revamped with support for multiple controllers and enhanced network capabilities. This new system provides better redundancy, improved power distribution, and enhanced network stability for large-scale storage solutions.

Key features:$(li)Multi-controller support$(li)Improved power distribution$(li)Enhanced network stability$(li)Better error handling$(li)Real-time monitoring$(li)Automatic load balancing$(br2)Multiple controllers work together seamlessly to manage larger networks more efficiently.

Multi-Controller Benefits:$(li)Enhanced redundancy$(li)Better power management$(li)Improved network reliability$(li)Increased maximum network size$(li)Better performance scaling$(li)Enhanced error recovery$(br2)Controllers automatically coordinate to optimize network performance.

Setup Tips:$(li)Place controllers strategically$(li)Connect via network cables$(li)Monitor power distribution$(li)Configure network priorities$(li)Use the Network Tool for diagnostics$(br2)The new system automatically handles controller coordination and load balancing.
